$comment: Ground truth for SECOND WORLD recall/precision on conduit-api (docs/12-testing-and-quality.md §3). Same format as examples/shop-express/expected-findings.json: location.line = the line after the SEEDED-DEFECT marker (refresh with `node examples/_tools/sync-expected-findings.mjs examples/conduit-api`); detectedBy = the CLI commands that find the defect with exactly this folder's sw.config.ts (finding ruleId + operation, title fragment or location); detectableFromConfig: false (+ reason) marks defects no engine finds from the config today. `observations` = documented findings that are not defects. Checked by tests/system/conduit.test.ts.

defects.title: Off-by-one in pagination: GET /api/articles returns limit + 1 articles
defects.fix: Drop the look-ahead row: rows.slice(0, limit) (or LIMIT ? with limit)

defects.title: N+1 queries in GET /api/articles: author, tags and favorited are loaded per article
defects.reproduction: GET /api/articles?limit=20 runs 2 + 3 x 21 queries (see GET /__test/stats); the feed with the same page size runs 6
defects.fix: Assemble the page with the batched ArticleRepository.views() the feed uses (WHERE article_id IN (...))

defects.title: 500 on GET /api/articles/{slug} when the slug has characters outside Latin-1 (e.g. emoji)
defects.fix: Do not echo raw input in headers (encodeURIComponent the slug, or drop Content-Location)

defects.title: Missing ownership check: any signed-in user can delete another user's article
defects.reproduction: alice creates an article; bob DELETEs /api/articles/<alice's slug> -> 204 (contract: 403)
defects.fix: Return 403 unless article.author_id === current user (as PUT does)
defects.description: Found by sw bugs (auth technique, BOLA on DELETE) since the wave-7 fix in src/engines/bugs/generate.ts (BOLA cases per secured operation; before it, a public read operation skipped the whole resource).

defects.title: Lost update on favoritesCount: read-modify-write across awaits without a transaction
defects.fix: INSERT OR IGNORE the favorite and UPDATE favorites_count = favorites_count + 1 in one transaction (as unfavorite does)

observations.reason: Per-run experiment summary (info). Not a defect.
